messages:
monitoring-bot: ALERT: eu-central-1 region 5xx rate spike > 2.0% for 10m. Possible regional degradation. alert: ALRT-20260320-77 https://internal.redwood/alerts/ALRT-20260320-77
Maya (oncall): acknowledged, taking it. switching to incident mode and opening live doc.
deploy-bot: deployment/session-proxy v3.1.0 rolled to eu-central-1 at 2026-03-20T11:05Z (trigger: ci/cd).
Maya (oncall): noted deploy timing. infra-team: any LB config changes or traffic engineering pushes in last 30m?
infra-team: no manual LB pushes. autoscaler did add nodes at 11:02Z due to synthetic load.
SRE_Paul: adding context from morning: we had a config tweak to cache sizing in canary earlier today; might be related to cache eviction behavior.
Maya (oncall): pulling service logs and GC traces. curl /health on a few instances shows elevated p95 latency and intermittent 502s.
ops-bot: synthetic-check eu-central cache-path latency > 1200ms (sustained).
Maya (oncall): logs show repeated GC stop-the-world events on session-proxy JVMS. sample: ```[2026-03-20T11:07:12Z] WARN GC Pause "G1 Evacuation Pause" 6328ms; heap live 3.9G/6G```
PM_Lina: customer-impact check: which tenants were routed to eu-central at spike start? can we get top affected?
Maya (oncall): partial customer impact. auto-failover exists but circuit-breaker hysteresis and weighted routing prevented full immediate shift. recommending controlled weight change to protect sessions.
SRE_Paul: propose reducing eu-central weight to 15% for new sessions and routing remainder to eu-west and us-east. also suggest pausing canary rollout for session-proxy until we confirm memory behavior.
Maya (oncall): applying weight change gradually (15% over 4m). initiating canary pause.
infra-team: applying pager silence for the noisy 5xx group: ```/pager silence ALRT-20260320-77 45m "incident triage"```
monitoring-bot: Pager: silence applied to ALRT-20260320-77 for 45m by infra-team.
deploy-bot: rollback initiated for session-proxy v3.1.0 canaries in eu-central-1.
Maya (oncall): traffic shift observed: 5xx count dropping ~60% in first 2m post weight change.
PM_Lina: drafting status update: "Investigating increased errors in EU region; traffic is being shifted to healthy regions. Some users may experience transient failures. We will provide updates every 20 minutes." Approve?
SRE_Paul: approved. also capture impacted sessions % for the RCA.
Maya (oncall): tuning suggestion: split region 5xx alert into severity tiers (WARN 1.0-2.5%, CRIT >2.5%), and add an alert for sustained per-instance GC pause >5s and a new 'failover-amplification' alert that fires if traffic weight moves >30% within 5m to catch routing flaps.
infra-team: +1 on GC alert and failover-amplification. we should also add a deploy-gate: fail deploys if heap-pressure metric increases >20% during canary.
Maya (oncall): creating an alerts PR and a dashboard change request. sample rules Ill add to alerts.yaml:
```
- name: ALRT-REGION-WARN
  expr: region_5xx_rate > 0.01 for: 5m
  labels: severity: warning
- name: ALRT-REGION-CRIT
  expr: region_5xx_rate > 0.025 for: 3m
  labels: severity: critical
- name: ALRT-GC-PAUSE
  expr: instance_gc_pause_ms > 5000 for: 2m
  labels: severity: critical
- name: ALRT-FAILOVER-AMPLIFY
  expr: change(region_outbound_weight_percent[5m]) > 30
  labels: severity: warning
```
ops-bot: creating incident INC-20260320-102 "eu-central elevated errors". Incident commander: Maya (oncall).
SRE_Paul: also request a new multi-region synth that hits cache-heavy endpoints in eu-west and eu-central every 5m and records GC/heap metrics. tag as critical-synth.
Maya (oncall): ticket TKT-5598 filed: "Alert tiers, GC pause alert, failover amplification alert, synth monitors, and multi-region dashboard panel" assigned to infra-team, ETA 4d.
Maya (oncall): preparing handoff notes: if unresolved when I finish shift in 1.5h, handoff to SRE_Paul as IC. actions taken so far: 1) paused canary 2) rolled back canaries 3) controlled weight shift to 15% eu-central 4) silenced noisy alert 5) opened alerts PR and TKT-5598 6) added temp grafana panel to show weight changes + 5xx overlay at https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/multi-region-failover
infra-team: will add deploy gate for heap-pressure in pipeline. also agree to add a small ramping synthetic during future canaries to surface GC regressions early.
monitoring-bot: update: eu-central 5xx rate reduced to 0.35% at 2026-03-20T11:24Z after mitigation. Incident state: MONITORING.
PM_Lina: thanks. please ensure affected tenant list and percent impacted are attached to incident doc for customer comms and postmortem.
Maya (oncall): noted. adding metrics and tenant list to INC-20260320-102. handing over watch to SRE_Paul if anything recurs.
